:::{#exm-cartesian-product}
#### Cartesian products

- $\set{1, 2} \times \set{5, 6} = \set{(1, 5), (1, 6), (2, 5), (2, 6)}$.
  The pair $(5, 1)$ is not in it,
  because its first entry, $5$, is not in $\set{1, 2}$;
  so $(1, 5) \ne (5, 1)$.
- The results of rolling a die twice form
  $\set{1, \ldots, 6} \times \set{1, \ldots, 6}$,
  which has $6 \cdot 6 = 36$ elements, such as $(3, 5)$:
  a 3 on the first roll and a 5 on the second.
- $[0, 2] \times [0, 3]$ is the set of points $(x, y)$ in the plane
  with $0 \le x \le 2$ and $0 \le y \le 3$:
  a rectangle of width $2$ and height $3$.

:::
